summary.text: Kolton Jones is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 25, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Hans Wilz.
A paramedic in Ottumwa, he says he is running on health care, clean water and public education.

paragraphs.text: Kolton Jones graduated from Ottumwa High School, earned a bachelor's degree from William Penn University in 2021, and completed coursework at Indian Hills Community College in 2023.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in Ottumwa and works as a paramedic on the ambulance there, and that he is running so that Ottumwa and Wapello County have a representative who fights for the everyday Iowan.
He listed his key messages as affordable health care, reversing the privatization of Medicaid, addressing nitrates in Iowa's waterways, and using public money for public education.
